summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — ENR.DE +8%, IFX.DE +5%, ASM.AS +4%, STMPA.PA +4%, SPX.L +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (BNR.DE -3%, EL.PA -2%, BTRW.L -1%, ZAL.DE -1%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: ENR.DE (+8.18%) — Not confirmed by any same-day source. Likely Siemens Energy's FY Q4 results and updated 2030 targets, which were reportedly scheduled for 11 Nov, with the stock reacting to the guidance and gas-turbine/grid demand outlook. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: ENR.DE is a large-cap German industrial/energy-equipment name (DAX), and no uk-eu strategy includes it. The move was also a results-day gap, which a post-open momentum filter would see too late.
